definitions.explanation: Education focused on physical fitness and sports skills; also refers to athletics and physical exercise in general.

examples.japanese: {今日|きょう}の{体育|たいいく}は{水泳|すいえい}だ。
{体育|たいいく}の{授業|じゅぎょう}でマラソンを{走|はし}った。
examples.english: We ran a marathon in PE class.

examples.japanese: {体育|たいいく}の{日|ひ}には{学校|がっこう}で{運動会|うんどうかい}がある。
examples.english: On Sports Day, there is an athletic meet at school.
examples.notes: 体育の日 = Sports Day (national holiday)

notes:
COMMON COMPOUNDS:
- {体育館|たいいくかん} (gymnasium)
- {体育祭|たいいくさい} (sports festival)
- {体育|たいいく}の{日|ひ} (Sports Day - national holiday in October)

SCHOOL CONTEXT:
- {体育|たいいく}の{授業|じゅぎょう} (PE class)
- {体育|たいいく}の{先生|せんせい} (PE teacher)

CULTURAL NOTE: {体育|たいいく}の{日|ひ} (Sports Day) is a national holiday established to commemorate the 1964 Tokyo Olympics.
